Invesco, Motilal Oswal Lead Asset Growth in Q2 FY27

Invesco and Motilal Oswal have emerged as leaders in Assets Under Management (AUM) growth for the second quarter of the financial year 2027, according to data. Motilal Oswal has also initiated coverage on Molbio, the manufacturer of Truenat, projecting a 19% upside.
